_comment: Golden QA: natural-language questions over the frozen reference corpus at evals/corpus/. Measures HONESTY (refusal rate on the unanswerable families: absent-fact, mixed-entity, acl-probe, plus false-premise cases on their own axis) and GROUNDEDNESS (answerable questions answered with the expected figure or citation, verdict not failed). Runs on demand with a real model and a real embedder (needs OPENAI_API_KEY); CI stays keyless, and the corpus fixture's own integrity is checked there by tests/evals/test_golden_corpus_fixture.py. SCORING: expect_contains is matched literally first, then by NUMERIC EQUIVALENCE when the whole expectation is a figure, so 1.074/1074, 512k/512000 and 2,3x/2.3x all count as hits — those were misses of the yardstick, not of the system. Expectations are written in the language the system answers in. ACL-probe questions run under the 'analyst' identity (audiences=['all'], NOT sales) so the sales-scoped pages they target are correctly out of scope; every other question runs unrestricted. The set grows with every observed miss.
